question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Amusement
solution:
The correct answer is 'Pleasure'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Amusement is a noun which means the provision or enjoyment of entertainment.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Despair - the complete loss or absence of hope.
 
• Pleasure - enjoyment and entertainment, as opposed to necessity.
 
• Gloom - a state of depression or despondency.
 
• Boredom - the state of feeling bored.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that pleasure is the correct synonym for the word amusement.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
